(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that (1) explicitly focuses on national-scale land use and land cover (LULC) prediction in China (mainland, excluding only Taiwan and South China Sea Islands as noted); (2) has LULC simulation as its primary objective, using the PLUS model to project changes from 2030 to 2060; (3) implements and quantitatively compares three distinct policy scenarios (baseline, cropland protection, green development); (4) employs spatially explicit modeling with reported quantitative accuracy metrics—kappa = 0.827, OA = 0.878, FOM = 0.161—and validates model performance against alternative models (e.g., FLUS); and (5) provides mapped LULC projections for 2030 and 2060 under each scenario. All core inclusion criteria are met, and no exclusion criteria apply.)
